$comment: Every numeric knob a gate reads from the environment, classified. A BUDGET is a bound whose loosening weakens a control; loosening one is the edit this repository has the least protection against, because it leaves a green run behind it. G7 asks WHO moved a limit. Nothing asked whether the number that moved still agrees with the sentence that states it - and one of them did not: EHS_MAX_TREE_BYTES was documented as 524288 while 786432 was enforced, wrong since the second of three re-baselines. The fix that raises a number makes the note that states it false, and no test sees that.
$comment_why_classify_everything: A ledger that lists only what someone remembered to list cannot see what nothing points at. So gate-budget-ledger.sh enumerates EVERY `${EHS_*:-<number>}` in scripts/gates/**, and a knob absent from this file FAILS - it is not silently assumed to be a switch. Classifying it as `not_a_budget` is a decision someone writes down, under G7, not a gap.
$comment_what_it_cannot_check: Whether a `measured` claim is TRUE. A gate cannot re-run the reasoning that justified a number, and one that pretended to would be worse than this one. What it enforces is that the claim EXISTS, sits beside the number, and that the number is the same in every place the repository states it. The run says so in a NOT MEASURED line rather than leaving it implied.

EHS_MAX_TREE_BYTES.why: outer bound on the tree served to the user: a bulk dump stays an order of magnitude away. The binding control on 'too much at once' is gate-tree-delta.sh, which does not go slack as the corpus grows.
EHS_MAX_TREE_BYTES.measured: 653,513 B served against a 655,360 B cap on main - 1,847 bytes of headroom, less than a tenth of one procedure. The cap was already spent and the next increment was going to trip it.
EHS_MAX_TREE_BYTES.last_set: 2026-09-01, third re-baseline, recorded in the gate header

EHS_MAX_TREE_FILES.why: a file count is the second axis of the same blast radius; a tree that fits the byte budget as a thousand tiny files is not the tree that was reviewed.
EHS_MAX_TREE_FILES.measured: judgement - 41 files served today, so the bound has never been near. It has never moved.

EHS_MAX_SKILL_MD_BYTES.why: SKILL.md is loaded whole every time the skill fires; its cost is neither optional nor amortisable. The answer to needing more is references/, not a higher number.
EHS_MAX_SKILL_MD_BYTES.measured: 12 KiB is about 3,000 tokens. The file weighs ~12,281 B today - 7 bytes of headroom, which is T-ehs-23.

EHS_MAX_REF_BYTES.why: the binding control on what any single agent must read in one go; unlike the tree cap it does not loosen as the corpus grows.
EHS_MAX_REF_BYTES.measured: judgement, held since the first size budget and never raised. Five packs were SPLIT rather than the number lifted, which is the behaviour it was written to force.

EHS_TREE_DELTA_BOT_BYTES.why: the knowledge loop adds procedures, not chapters.
EHS_TREE_DELTA_BOT_BYTES.measured: judgement, set against the observed size of a single procedure.

EHS_TREE_DELTA_HUMAN_BYTES.why: the same guard with room for the largest change a person legitimately makes in one go.
EHS_TREE_DELTA_HUMAN_BYTES.measured: the largest legitimate change observed - the local-app pack.

EHS_MAX_WRITE_AGENTS.why: without the cap, 'derive the role from the declaration' would mean any agent could grant itself Write by adding a sentence.
EHS_MAX_WRITE_AGENTS.measured: 1 is the count that makes the rule mean anything; raising it is the change that empties it.

EHS_MIN_XREFS.why: how many OTHER procedures must cite a rule before it counts as load-bearing; one citation is an author citing themselves.
EHS_MIN_XREFS.measured: judgement. 2 is the smallest number that cannot be satisfied by a single author in a single file.

EHS_ALLOW_TOOLS_FRONTMATTER.why: a mode switch, not a bound: 1 permits `allowed-tools` in the frontmatter as an explicit human decision. Loosening it is visible in the run, not in a threshold.

EHS_REQUIRE_CLAUDE_CLI.why: a mode switch: 1 turns a missing `claude` binary from SKIP into rc 2. It only ever makes the gate stricter.

EHS_SELFTEST_CHILD.why: internal plumbing: marks an invocation launched BY the battery so it does not recurse. Not a bound at all.
